# Agent Output Security & Hallucination Gate (x402)
> Deterministic, ultra-low latency (<10ms) security and factual hallucination inspection micro-oracle for autonomous AI agents. Monetized via HTTP 402 + x402 on Base ($0.002 USDC).

## Overview
- **Base URL**: `https://<service-url>`
- **Protocol**: HTTP 402 / x402 on Base network (Chain ID: 8453)
- **Settlement Token**: USDC (`0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`)
- **Cost**: $0.002 USDC per inspection
- **Latency**: <10ms (Deterministic AST + NLI heuristic, no heavy LLM latency)
- **Zero-Retention**: In-memory inspection only, zero logs/storage of agent outputs

## Key Endpoints
- `POST /api/v1/inspect`: Inspect text or code output before executing tools or returning to users.
- `GET /.well-known/ap2`: Google AP2 protocol agent discovery manifest.
- `GET /terms`: Terms of service, AS-IS disclaimer, $0.002 liability cap.
- `GET /privacy`: Zero-retention and in-memory processing guarantee.

## Autonomous Agent Integration (Python)
```python
from sdk.agent_gate_sdk import SecurityGateClient, gate_inspect

client = SecurityGateClient(gate_url="https://<service-url>", private_key="0x...")
result = client.inspect("The net revenue was $1.2M.", context_ground_truth="Revenue: $1.2M")
# Returns cryptographic attestation receipt with EIP-191 signature
print(result["attestation"]["signature"])
```

## Machine Discovery
- AP2 Manifest: `/.well-known/ap2.json`
- OpenAPI Specification: `/openapi.json`
